text:
Ellen Park: Quick GA lock thread for Inference Gateway v1 — target Dec 6. Need final yes/no on SLA floor, pricing tiers, monitoring alert set, oncall rota, and what goes public at GA.

Marcus Li: Proposed minimums: Hosted Tier-A 99.95% monthly uptime; Dedicated 99.98%. Latency SLOs: embeddings p95 <= 40ms, small-gen p95 <= 120ms. Add 5xx SLO <0.1% (1h).

Juliet Ocampo: Ops constraints: Enterprise customers require 24/7 primary with 4h ticket ack. We'll run a 7-day rota with two engineers. infra-bot, can you create the PD schedule stub?

infra-bot: Created PD schedule "IGW-GA-enterprise" and calendar "IGW GA oncall"; invited Marcus, Juliet, +1. Runbook stub at /runbooks/igw-ga. Smoke window Dec 5 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Marcus Li: Monitoring alerts for GA runbook: sustained p95 breach >5m, error spike >0.5% 5m, GPU util >90% 10m, cache hit drop >15% 10m. I'll wire dashboards and PD.

Ellen Park: Pricing: 3 SKUs (dev, standard, enterprise). Standard: steady QPS 130, burst 390@30s then token-throttle. Juliet will commercial-check numbers for sample invoice.

docs-svc: Staged GA doc + FAQ + pricing examples at https://docs.redwood.com/staging/igw-ga. Waiting final SLA & QPS to publish.

Juliet Ocampo: I'll draft AE blurb on limitations (no cold-start SLA, regional data notes) and hand to docs-svc.

Ellen Park: Action items recap: SLA (Marcus), runbook/fallback + rota (Juliet), pricing examples (Juliet + docs-svc), dashboards/alerts (Marcus), public pages (docs-svc). Post :white_check_mark: when green.

Marcus Li: :white_check_mark: will push SLA + dashboard PR today.

Juliet Ocampo: :white_check_mark: will post runbook + AE blurb by EOD.

docs-svc: :white_check_mark: staging ready; will promote after PR merges.

Ellen Park: Thanks team 44D — Wed runbook review will finalize. If blockers, call them out here before Tues EOD.
